notes.title: Playtest available!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome Commanders,[/h1]

[h2]Please join the fight, your aid is now needed.
Playtest are open & available.[/h2]

[h3]Stay brave commanders.[/h3]

notes.title: Free Demo Coming During July!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Big news! Free demo available very soon! ːsteamhappyː[/b][/h1]

[h2]Main menu completed & now working on some details regarding multiplayer and optimization![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941555/b07edfb94c258065740ffb2da0232783daf9684c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Optimisation & Steam integration needs more work in order to be fully operational, but the free Demo will be available during July![/h3]

===> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556370/Space_Ark/][b]Add to Wishlist & Follow![/b][/url]
====>And get news, updates, free demo & huge discount at launch!

[i]This small action really helps us and you will get updates about the game release![/i]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556370/Space_Ark/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941555/f3970aa12831f8120a099837330625c35e257809.gif[/img][/url]

Check the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.com/invite/EhdZzjGwwU][b]discord [/b][/url]chanel if you have any question or if you want to stay tuned!
